annotations.text:
Section order, always the same:

1. Summary line + labels
2. Description
3. Which issue(s)
4. PR acceptance criteria
5. How to test changes
6. Special notes to the reviewer

Only presence varies. A section with nothing to say is dropped, never filled with N/A.

No tables anywhere.

The labels are inline code spans, the sections are <details>. Both are plain Markdown, so they also render in e-mail notifications and the GitHub mobile app — which nested HTML tables do not.
